source_semantics.identity: The canonical Guid job id maps to the existing Laravel operation_executions.correlation_id exposed by EnqueueExternal as job_id; the internal numeric row_id is never accepted as the canonical identifier.
source_semantics.selection: CompleteExternal selects the requested owner's ExecutionMode.External job and returns without change when it is missing or not Running.
source_semantics.terminal_transition: A qualifying Running External job becomes Completed, progress becomes 100, processed items become total items, CompletedAt is set, and any prior Error is cleared.
source_semantics.activity: Exactly one Success activity is appended with the caller-supplied completion message as part of the completion write.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: The operation reuses the already-integrated tenant-owned operation_executions and operation_logs control plane created by ExecutionCenterService.EnqueueExternal; no second execution ledger is introduced.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_scope: The active TenantContext supplies tenant identity; operations.manage is authorized server-side; the active membership user must equal ownerUserId; the row lookup repeats tenant_id, canonical correlation_id and requested_by_user_id constraints under a transaction row lock.
laravel_adaptation.external_mode_mapping: Canonical ExecutionMode.External is preserved in the operation_executions payload as execution_mode=External and must be present before completion.
laravel_adaptation.state_mapping: Canonical Running/Completed map to running/completed. progress becomes 100, payload.processed_items becomes payload.total_items, failure becomes null, and completed_at is set.
laravel_adaptation.activity_mapping: A successful state transition writes exactly one success operation_log with source ExecutionCenterService.CompleteExternal and operation ID AIMW-AUTO-0701C84252; repeated or ineligible completion writes no success log.
laravel_adaptation.redaction: Credential-like assignments in the completion message are redacted before persistence.

proofs: exact canonical service/domain/source/member and operation ID AIMW-AUTO-0701C84252
canonical Guid job identity is preserved through correlation_id/job_id rather than the internal numeric row id
only Running External rows transition to completed
terminal state persists progress=100, processed_items=total_items, completed_at and cleared failure
exactly one success activity is created and duplicate completion cannot append another
missing, non-Running and non-External rows safely no-op without activity
wrong owner and missing operations.manage authorization fail closed
foreign-tenant row is invisible from the active tenant and remains unchanged
missing TenantContext fails closed before persistence
credential-like message assignments are redacted before the success log is stored
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/manual evidence is required: CompleteExternal records terminal metadata for externally performed work but does not itself perform or claim the external work.
